facts.label: Resistance penalty
facts.note: Added to fire, cold, lightning and poison resist.

facts.label: Life leech divisor
facts.note: Life leech % is divided by this.

facts.label: Mana leech divisor
facts.note: Mana leech % is divided by this.

facts.label: Class block factor
facts.note: Shield block = (BlockFactor + block) × (Dexterity − 15) / (2 × character level), capped at 75.

facts.label: Monsters that cannot be leeched
facts.note: Enabled monsters (of 1424) whose Drain is 0 or blank, per difficulty: no life or mana leech against them.

facts.label: Monsters with reduced leech
facts.note: Enabled monsters whose Drain is between 1 and 99: leech against them is scaled by Drain / 100.

facts.label: Crushing Blow strength per target, % of vanilla
facts.note: The plugin scales the vanilla share of current life per target class; 100 = vanilla.

facts.label: Crushing Blow share of current life per target (melee, one player)
facts.note: Vanilla share × setting / 100. Classes do not stack: mercenary → act_boss → super_unique → unique → champion → minion → monster. The config comments disagree with the values: unique = 25 gives 6.25 % of current life, but its config comment says "50 -> 12.5 %". The value is what the plugin reads.

facts.label: Ranged Crushing Blow, % of melee
facts.note: Missile and thrown hits; vanilla halves Crushing Blow for them.

facts.label: Deadly Strike Damage stat id
facts.note: Its value is added to the base multiplier: +50 turns a ×2 critical into ×2.5.

facts.label: Critical multiplier
facts.note: Deadly Strike, Critical Strike and weapon-mastery criticals share one doubling: only one of them applies per hit.

facts.label: Dodge, Avoid and Evade cap
facts.note: Per-stat overrides of -1 inherit cap_percent. The stat on items is not changed, only the roll.

facts.label: Faster Cast Rate cap
facts.note: FCR past this point does nothing. Effective FCR = 120 × FCR / (FCR + 120).

facts.label: Highest cast animation rate
facts.note: Rate = 100 + effective FCR at the cap (derived). Frames = ceil(256 × FramesPerDirection / (AnimationSpeed × rate / 100)) − 1.

facts.label: Magic Find soft tail, % of raw MF added
facts.note: Effective MF = dim × MF / (MF + dim) + MF × tail / 100 for unique, set and rare items.

facts.label: Hit chance curve
facts.note: r = attack rating / defense. Below the pivot 100 × r^s / (r^s + pivot^s), above it 50 + 50 × (r − pivot) / ((r − pivot) + tail), the late tail blended in between blendStart and blendEnd; whole percents, snapped to 100 at snapTo100At, then the limits.

facts.label: Hit chance at attack rating / defense ratios (config comment)
facts.note: The default curve as the plugin author lists it, before min_chance and max_chance.

facts.label: Bleed stat and state ids
facts.note: A hit that still deals physical damage rolls a percent from min to max; the bleed deals physical × percent / 100 over the length (frames, 25 per second) averaged over the sources that carry a length. A stronger bleed replaces a weaker one; bleed and poison stack.

facts.label: Weapon block: claw item types (one in each hand)
facts.note: Not capped at 75 like shield block; no weapon block while moving.

facts.label: Weapon block: sword item types (one in each hand, or one two-handed)
facts.note: Not capped at 75 like shield block; no weapon block while moving.

facts.label: Allied summons have capped resists
facts.note: Allies (monstats Align 1) use the player caps: 75 + max resist, at most 95; physical 50; no difficulty penalty.

facts.label: Attacker Takes Damage kills count
facts.note: Thorns kills give kill credit and trigger on-kill effects.

facts.label: Poison immunity state id
facts.note: A unit in this state takes no poison over time.

facts.label: Off-weapon Enhanced Damage fix enabled
facts.note: Off-weapon Enhanced Damage is no longer lost when the item (or a jewel in it) also has flat minimum or maximum damage.

facts.label: Increased Quantity of Items Found
facts.note: percent = 1: the stat is a percent chance of one extra pick from the monster’s own treasure class (150 = one plus 50 %).

facts.label: Lowest resistance
facts.note: Every unit; the 95 ceiling and the 50 physical cap are unchanged. Damage taken = (100 − resist) %.

facts.label: Running keeps block and defense
facts.note: Vanilla divides block by 3 while moving and makes attacks always hit a running player; ESR removes both.

facts.label: Summons use the player damage % vs prime evils
facts.note: Pets hitting a prime evil are scaled by difficultylevels.txt PlayerDamagePercentVSPrimeEvil, like players.

facts.label: Magic Find diminishing returns
facts.note: Magic items get the full MF.

facts.label: Leech precision
facts.note: Leech is kept in 1/64 of a percent after the divisor: floor(leech × 64 / divisor).

facts.label: Monster life per extra player (/players)
facts.note: Crushing Blow against monsters is divided by 1 + this × (players − 1) / 100.

facts.label: Speed stat diminishing returns
facts.note: Effective = k × value / (value + k).
